environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group 'tenant-isolation-enforcement' with priority 1 that inspects the URI path against a DynamoDB-backed Lambda authorizer integration. Specifically, the rule uses a regex pattern set matching '/api/v1/invoices/[0-9]+' and cross-references the X-User-ID header value against an AWS WAFv2 custom response via a rule action override. Additionally, an AWS WAFv2 rate-based rule (threshold: 100 requests/5min per IP) is applied. The ALB also has a listener rule that injects a verified X-Tenant-Scope header derived from the Cognito JWT sub claim via ALB's built-in OIDC authentication action, but the application code does not consume this header for authorization decisions. A separate CloudFront distribution with origin request policy strips and re-signs the X-User-ID header based on the CloudFront signed cookie tenant binding before forwarding to the ALB origin.

config.infrastructure: CloudFront -> AWS WAFv2 WebACL -> ALB (OIDC auth action) -> EC2
waf_rules: Custom rule group 'tenant-isolation-enforcement' (priority 1) - regex URI match with header cross-reference
config.cloudfront_config: Origin request policy rewrites X-User-ID header from signed cookie tenant claim; unsigned requests get header stripped
config.alb_auth: OIDC authentication action with Cognito user pool; injects X-Tenant-Scope but app ignores it
config.cognito: User pool with tenant_id custom attribute in JWT
